label: KTB node is the T node plus a symmetric frame (inference)
rule: Conjunction regrouping under the root witness: frame class KTB is KT together with symmetry
meaning: Certified difference (#1598) of the registration KTB node strengthens T node: for every world type, signature, profile, world and relation, the KTB node holds iff the T node holds and the route's frame is symmetric. Premise-free; it compares the two encodings and asserts no frame class of the route.
